Seen • Just now
No worries — it’s very simple to start.
Basic setup:
Put a little moisture on the tragus (the small bump on your ear).
Place the earpiece on your left ear, with the electrodes on the tragus and the cable over/behind your ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the level until you feel a light tingling sensation. 
How to use it:
Use it for 30–60 minutes per day, ideally in the morning or split between morning and evening.
You can go about normal activities while using it (reading, working, relaxing, etc.).
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually increase while keeping the sensation pleasant and comfortable. 
If you want, I can also walk you through a simple daily routine to make it easy to build into your day.
